title: Dravid/ORIGINAL
text: Dravid was named one of the Wisden Cricketers of the Year by Wisden Cricketers' Almanack in 2000 and received the Player of the Year and the Test Player of the Year awards at the inaugural ICC awards ceremony in 2004. In December 2011, he was the first non-Australian cricketer to deliver the Bradman Oration in Canberra. As of May 2026, he is the fifth-highest run scorer in Test cricket, and was the first player to score a century in all ten Test-playing countries (now 12). He holds the records for the most balls faced in Test cricket and the longest time spent batting in Tests.
